arm.speaker: Marguerite
lines: His arm — mind his arm. Luc, keep the lamp low.

seen_silk.speaker: Henri
lines: American. Listen to me. Your silk was seen from the road. No sound — the night has ears, and they will come to count.

unseen.speaker: Henri
lines: American. Listen to me. No one saw you fall but the boy. Keep it that way — not a word, not a light.

shoulders.speaker: Henri
lines: Luc. Take his shoulders. Quickly now.
